findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 137 requests to 27 third-party domains (median of 2 passes).
Of 5.1 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 2.4 MB (47%) came from third-party domains, 871 kB of it from services classified as tracking (35 requests).

12 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising), amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising), creativecdn.com (RTB House, advertising), doubleclick.net (Google, advertising), facebook.com (Meta, social), facebook.net (Meta, social), googlesyndication.com (Google, advertising), id5-sync.com (ID5, advertising), imasdk.googleapis.com (Google, advertising), mrf.io (Marfeel, analytics).
7 cookies were set by third-party domains (43 cookies in total).
The main document response did not include a Strict-Transport-Security header.
The main document response did not include a Content-Security-Policy header or meta tag.

With the EasyPrivacy filter list applied (domain rules only, 47222 rules), 17 requests were blocked. The page still made 137 requests to 27 third-party domains, including 12 tracking services in our list.
